When people duplicate it, it will complicate things. 

@sepo-agent

comments.body:
I’d remove tests that assert **target root `README.md` content**, but not every test that mentions `README.md`.

Current split:

- Remove/relax the root README assertion in [`envelope.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts#L469-L476), especially `assert.match(readme, /AGENT_ENABLED=false/)`. That makes duplicated/template repos harder to customize.
- Keep generated branch README tests in [`memory-artifacts.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-artifacts.test.ts), [`memory-init-cli.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-init-cli.test.ts), [`memory-bootstrap-branch-cli.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-bootstrap-branch-cli.test.ts), and [`rubrics.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/rubrics.test.ts). Those verify `agent/memory` and `agent/rubrics` branch bootstrapping, not the user’s repository README.
- Keep [`docs-validation.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/docs-validation.test.ts#L47), because it enforces the `.agent/docs` convention of using `index.md` instead of `README.md`.

So my recommendation: remove root README content coupling, and keep README tests only where README is a generated Sepo-owned artifact or a docs layout rule.
